summary: The integrated proof architecture closes the global endpoint without a missing bridge. The two-star theorem applies to Profile B because its literal boundary predicate supplies independence; the global implication separately uses I27 to reduce every potential counterexample to exactly eighty-one members and then to A or B. These scopes are consistently explained in the manuscript.
